description: This file defines a controller class for managing 'Return Actions' within the OpenCart admin localization module. It handles listing, editing, creating, deleting, and saving return action entries, including processing form submissions, permissions, and rendering views with pagination and sorting features.

classes.name: ReturnAction
classes.description: Controller class for handling CRUD operations for return actions in the localisation section of OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to list return actions with sorting and pagination support.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Prepares data and renders the list view of return actions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and formats list of return actions based on current sorting and pagination settings.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a return action.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form data to create or update a return action and returns JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return actions and returns JSON response.
